issues.display_title: Issue #1754: Standardize Stripe transid to charge id (ch_) in cc_logs and cc_purchase
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Standardize transid in cc_logs and cc_purchase to the Stripe charge id (ch_...) for Stripe payments, across the subscribe and subscribe-3ds flows.

Current state

For subscriptions created via POST /v2/payment/subscription/subs and completed via POST /v2/payment/subscription/complete-3ds (SubscriptionHelpers::handlePaymentSuccess()), transid is populated inconsistently:

  • cc_logs.transid = Stripe customer id (cus_...) — set in SubscriptionHelpers::logPaymentSuccess().
  • cc_purchase.transid = Stripe subscription id (sub_..., recurring) or PaymentIntent id (pi_..., one-time) — set in SubscriptionHelpers::generateAndSaveInvoice() → CCTransClass::insert().

Neither matches InvoiceHelper::classifyPaymentProcessorByTransId(), which only recognizes the legacy ch_(1|3)... charge-id shape — so every row from this flow classifies as unrecognized_format, and the Stripe product-lookup fallback (applyStripeProductFilter()) that depends on that classification never fires for new rows.

The receipt/invoice lookup path (InvoiceHelper::normalizeTransactionId(), findPurchaseByTransaction()) already assumes a ch_-prefixed id — it strips the ch_ prefix and matches either form. That code was written for charge ids; the subscribe flow just never supplied one.

Target state

Both cc_logs.transid and cc_purchase.transid store the Stripe charge id (ch_...) for Stripe payments, resolved from:

  • Recurring subscriptions: the charge behind invoice.payment_intent.latest_charge (needs an extra expand level beyond the current latest_invoice.payment_intent).
  • One-time payments: paymentIntent.latest_charge (needs expand: ['latest_charge'] on paymentIntents->create()).

Same expand additions are needed on the 3DS resume path, which re-retrieves the subscription/invoice/PaymentIntent from Stripe before finalizing (CompleteSubs3DS::handle()).

Scope

  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/SubscriptionHelpers.php
    • logPaymentSuccess() — write charge id instead of customer->id to cc_logs.TransID.
    • generateAndSaveInvoice() — write charge id instead of subsId to cc_purchase.transid.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Stripe/Subscription/Subscription.php
    • createStripeCustomerAndSubscription() — add expand for the charge on both the subscription and one-time payment intent creation calls.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Stripe/Subscription/CompleteSubs3DS.php
    • handle() — add the same expand on the subscription/invoice and PaymentIntent retrieve calls used to verify the 3DS result.

Out of scope

  • No backfill/migration of existing cc_logs/cc_purchase rows.
  • No changes to Upgrade, Downgrade, PayPal subscribe, or one-time non-subscription purchase flows — none of them write customer->id/subsId into transid.
  • No changes to subscription lifecycle code (cancel/upgrade/downgrade/proration) — that reads user_extra_data.recurring_profile, a separate column, not cc_purchase.transid.

Risk / test plan

  • Charge may not be attached to the invoice/PaymentIntent at the exact moment of the webhook-less synchronous flow (timing race) — verify latest_charge is populated before relying on it, add a fallback/log if null.
  • Manual QA in Stripe test mode across 4 paths: recurring direct success, recurring 3DS resume, one-time direct success, one-time 3DS resume.

issues.display_title: Issue #1756: Investigate: PayPal subscribe transid mismatch (cc_logs vs cc_purchase), same pattern as #1754
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Same class of problem as #1754, on the PayPal side: cc_logs.transid and cc_purchase.transid hold two different PayPal entity ids for PayPal subscribe payments, and the recurring path discards a capture id it already fetched.

Current state

SubscribeHandler.php (app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/Actions/SubscribeHandler.php) builds a mock $subscribe object and calls the same SubscriptionHelpers::handlePaymentSuccess() used by the Stripe flow. ChargeIdResolver::resolve() (added in #1754) correctly returns null for this PayPal-shaped object (it has no Stripe latest_invoice/latest_charge fields), so PayPal keeps its pre-#1754 behavior untouched — which has the same mismatch #1754 fixed for Stripe:

  • cc_logs.transid = customer->id = PayPal payer_id (logPaymentSuccess(), unchanged by #1754).
  • cc_purchase.transid = subsId = $subscribe->id, which is:
    • One-time (SubscribeHandler.php:140-146): $captureId ?? $transactionId — the PayPal capture id if available, else the order/transaction id. This is already close to right (capture id is PayPal's rough equivalent of a Stripe charge id).
    • Recurring (SubscribeHandler.php:152-176): the PayPal subscription id (I-...). A capture id IS fetched a few lines earlier ($captureId = $transaction['resource_id'] ?? null;, line 155) but is discarded for this purpose — it's only used later for refund calls in the error-handling catch block (lines 206-211), never for $subscribe->id.

Same downstream consequence as #1754: cc_logs.transid and cc_purchase.transid can't be joined on transid directly, and neither matches InvoiceHelper::classifyPaymentProcessorByTransId()'s recognized shapes (it has no PayPal capture-id pattern at all, only PayPal Express/Payflow legacy patterns — see InvoiceHelper.php:280-307).

Target state

To be designed (this issue is filed to track investigation + design, not scoped yet). Candidate direction based on #1754's approach: resolve a single PayPal capture id once per successful payment and write it to both cc_logs.transid and cc_purchase.transid, with the recurring path using the $captureId it already fetches instead of discarding it. Needs design discussion on:

  • Whether capture_id is reliably available for recurring subscriptions on first payment (the try/catch around getSubscriptionTransactions() in SubscribeHandler.php:153-160 suggests it isn't always).
  • Fallback behavior when no capture id is available, analogous to #1754's 100%-off-coupon fallback case.
  • Whether classifyPaymentProcessorByTransId() needs a new pattern branch for PayPal capture ids, or whether that's out of scope like it was for #1754's Stripe charge ids.

Out of scope (for this filing)

  • Not implementing anything yet — investigation/design only, follow the same brainstorming → spec → plan flow used for #1754 when picked up.
  • CaptureOrder.php / CaptureOverlayOrder.php (PayPal one-time non-subscription purchases) are a separate code path (PaymentHelpers::logSuccessPayment / LogSuccessPayment DTO) not covered by this investigation.

References

  • #1754 — the equivalent fix for Stripe subscribe/3ds, same root cause pattern.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/Actions/SubscribeHandler.php
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/SubscriptionHelpers.php (logPaymentSuccess(), generateAndSaveInvoice(), shared with Stripe)
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/CaptureSubscription.php (getSubscriptionTransactions(), captureOrder())

Result

PR: #1757

New PaypalTransIdResolver (sibling to #1754's ChargeIdResolver) resolves the PayPal capture id, falling back internally to the subscription/order id — never null, so cc_logs.transid and cc_purchase.transid can't diverge. SubscribeHandler.php now passes the capture id it already fetched through to this resolver; SubscriptionHelpers::handlePaymentSuccess() dispatches to it for $processor === 'paypal' (Stripe path untouched).

Design spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-10-paypal-transid-capture-id-design.md
Implementation plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-10-paypal-transid-capture-id.md

Status: Implemented, reviewed (task-level + final whole-branch review, "Ready to merge: Yes"), pushed. Manual PayPal-sandbox QA still pending before merge.

issues.display_title: Issue #1759: Store Stripe invoice_id in cc_purchase (Stripe-only, PayPal out of scope)
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Stripe-only. cc_purchase has an existing invoice_id column that is never written. Populate it for the Stripe payment path where a real Stripe Invoice exists: new subscribe (recurring), upgrade, and space-addon. PayPal is explicitly out of scope — see Out of scope.

Current state

  • cc_purchase.invoice_id column exists but no code path writes to it — grep -rn "invoice_id" app/ returns zero matches.
  • All cc_purchase writes funnel through two chokepoints: PaymentHelpers::insertTransaction() and SubscriptionHelpers::generateAndSaveInvoice(), shared by Stripe and PayPal.
  • For flows that go through Stripe Invoicing (new subscribe recurring, upgrade, space-addon), the relevant Stripe Invoice object ($latestInvoice) is already fetched earlier in each flow — no new Stripe API call needed to get its id.

Target state

  • New subscribe (recurring), upgrade, and space-addon: cc_purchase.invoice_id populated with the Stripe Invoice id (in_...).
  • Explicitly null, not touched: PayPal (no Invoice concept), Stripe downgrade (scheduled change, no immediate invoice), Stripe one-time Charge/PaymentIntent purchases (not linked to Stripe Invoicing).

Scope

  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/PaymentHelpers.php — insertTransaction(): accept optional invoice_id key, default null.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/InvoiceIdResolver.php (new) — resolve a Stripe Invoice id off an already-fetched subscribe/PaymentIntent object, null for non-Stripe-shaped input. Sibling to ChargeIdResolver/PaypalTransIdResolver.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/UpgradeHelper.php — insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade(): thread optional invoiceId param through to insertTransaction().
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Stripe/Subscription/Upgrade.php, CompleteUpgrade3DS.php, SpaceAddon.php — pass invoiceId: $latestInvoice->id (already in scope at each call site).
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/SubscriptionHelpers.php — handlePaymentSuccess()/generateAndSaveInvoice(): resolve and store invoice_id for Stripe, hardcode null for PayPal.

Out of scope

  • PayPal invoice_id — no PayPal Invoice equivalent, stays null.
  • DowngradeHelper::insertCCPurchaseForDowngrade — no real Stripe invoice available at that point in the flow.
  • One-time unlock/token purchases (BuyTokenHelpers, Unlock*Helpers) — use charges->create() directly, never linked to a Stripe Invoice.
  • No backfill of existing cc_purchase rows. No migration — column already exists.

Risk / test plan

  • PaymentHelpers::insertTransaction() becomes a shared chokepoint for every payment flow app-wide (Stripe and PayPal). Before merge, confirm cc_purchase.invoice_id is nullable on production ccdb — if it's NOT NULL without a default, every insert breaks, not just the flows this issue targets.
  • Manual QA in Stripe test mode: recurring subscribe, one-time subscribe (invoice_id stays null), upgrade, space-addon — confirm invoice_id populates. Regression check: downgrade and PayPal subscribe still insert successfully with invoice_id staying null.

Result

Implemented in PR #1758 (branch worktree-cc-purchase-invoice-id-stripe).

  • PaymentHelpers::insertTransaction() — accepts optional invoice_id key, default null.
  • New InvoiceIdResolver (app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/InvoiceIdResolver.php) — resolves a Stripe Invoice id off an already-fetched subscribe/PaymentIntent object, null for non-Stripe-shaped input.
  • UpgradeHelper::insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade() — threads optional invoiceId param through to insertTransaction().
  • Upgrade.php, CompleteUpgrade3DS.php, SpaceAddon.php — pass invoiceId: $latestInvoice->id (already in scope, no new Stripe API calls).
  • SubscriptionHelpers::handlePaymentSuccess()/generateAndSaveInvoice() — resolves and stores invoice_id for Stripe, hardcodes null for PayPal.

Tests: vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Helpers/Payment/ — 14/14 passing (5 new InvoiceIdResolverTest cases). php -l clean on all modified/new files. Final whole-branch review: 0 Critical, 2 Minor fixed in a follow-up commit.

Still open before merge (see Risk / test plan above): confirm cc_purchase.invoice_id is nullable on production ccdb, and manual QA in Stripe test mode — neither could be run in the build environment (no sandbox/network access).
